assessments.assessment: Loader pins original cases/world byte hashes independently of overlay. Whole-case deep copies retain prompts, config/resource/egress authority, expected assertions, setup/subscenarios, faults, interventions, dependencies and repetitions. Only Q01/Q06/C02/C03/C04/R02/R04/P03 authorization.consumer_node changes B to A. Exact role table enforced after schema validation.

All30 receive explicit provider/source/recipient/connector/history/default ownership metadata. Only Q02 source-broken becomes B; source-alpha/source-other remain A. C01 new source owner B. C03 default A and sharing false overlay retain original receiver grant arrays; C04 initial model-a sharing and B grant plus all original approval stages preserved. Source movement/setup directives are not executed by loader.

Four logical node IDs must map to distinct nonempty bounded strings; runtime/store consumer declarations and owner must match effective role/case. Caller-provided identity remains labeled declared_bindings_consistent with independent_identity_proof=false and physical_host_proof=false. No process identity, cryptographic authentication or two-host result is inferred.

Constant development paths, bounded reads, strict duplicate-key/nonfinite rejection, closed schema and canonical output digest bind provenance. Changed source bytes or edited overlay base digests are rejected. Inputs are never mutated and returned nested values are defensive copies. Explicit overlay/schema byte hashes are included.
